title: ReviewsEntitySplitRequest
description: reviews.entity-split-request@1: the body of reviews.entity.split on OpenVibe.Reviews: POST /api/v1/entities/:ref/split { note? } undoes the merge of :ref, decided by the editor named in X-OV-Subject (403 reviews.person_required / reviews.editor_required): the merged_into link ends (audited) and the pre-merge attribution is restored exactly. Refusals: 404 entity.not_found, 409 split.not_merged, 409 split.no_merge_link.
